instruction: Adjust the power settings to prevent the screen from dimming automatically during periods of inactivity.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic screen dimming when inactive in GNOME power settings. The evaluator checks if 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power idle-dim' returns 'false' (disabled). This is conceptually similar to the original task but targets a different power setting. This uses existing evaluator functions (exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter) - no custom functions needed.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if idle-dim is false, 0.0 otherwise
